import os
import sys
import time
import csv
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms, models
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from PIL import Image

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Start timing
start_time = time.time()

# Set device
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# Paths based on data overview
INPUT_DIR = Path("./input")
TRAIN_DIR = INPUT_DIR / "train"
TEST_DIR = INPUT_DIR / "test"
LABELS_FILE = INPUT_DIR / "labels.csv"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION = INPUT_DIR / "sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = Path("./submission")
SUBMISSION_FILE = SUBMISSION_DIR / "submission.csv"
WORKING_DIR = Path("./working")

# Create output directories
SUBMISSION_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if not WORKING_DIR.exists():
    WORKING_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# List files to verify paths exist
print(f"\nTraining images: {len(list(TRAIN_DIR.glob('*')))}")
print(f"Test images: {len(list(TEST_DIR.glob('*')))}")

# Load labels
labels_df = pd.read_csv(LABELS_FILE)
print(f"Labels shape: {labels_df.shape}")

# Get all breed names from labels
breed_names = sorted(labels_df["breed"].unique().tolist())
print(f"Number of breeds: {len(breed_names)}")

# Map IDs to indices
id_to_idx = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(breed_names)}
idx_to_id = {idx: name for idx, name in enumerate(breed_names)}

# Create mapping from filename/id to breed
label_map = dict(zip(labels_df["id"], labels_df["breed"]))


def get_transform(is_train=True):
    if is_train:
        return transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(256),
                transforms.CenterCrop(224),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.ColorJitter(
                    brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2, hue=0.1
                ),
            ]
        )
    else:
        return transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(256),
                transforms.CenterCrop(224),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )


train_transform = get_transform(is_train=True)
val_transform = get_transform(is_train=False)


class DogDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, image_dir, labels_df=None, transform=None, ids=None):
        self.image_dir = Path(image_dir)
        self.transform = transform

        if labels_df is not None:
            self.ids = labels_df["id"].values
            self.labels = labels_df["breed"].map(id_to_idx).values

        elif ids is not None:
            self.ids = ids
            self.labels = [id_to_idx[label_map[id]] for id in ids]

        else:
            # For test set, no labels - just filenames
            self.ids = sorted(
                [f.name.replace(".jpg", "") for f in self.image_dir.glob("*.jpg")]
            )
            self.labels = None

        print(f"Dataset size: {len(self)}")

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = self.image_dir / f"{self.ids[idx]}.jpg"

        try:
            image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        except Exception as e:
            # Handle cases where file might not exist
            image = Image.new("RGB", (224, 224))

        image = self.transform(image)

        return image, self.labels[idx] if self.labels[idx] is not None else None


# Split training data into train and validation
train_ids = labels_df["id"].tolist()
val_ids, train_ids = train_test_split(
    train_ids, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=labels_df["breed"]
)

# Create datasets
val_dataset = DogDataset(
    TRAIN_DIR,
    labels_df=labels_df[labels_df["id"].isin(val_ids)],
    transform=val_transform,
)
train_dataset = DogDataset(
    TRAIN_DIR,
    labels_df=labels_df[labels_df["id"].isin(train_ids)],
    transform=train_transform,
)

# Create dataloaders
BATCH_SIZE = 32
VAL_BATCH_SIZE = 64

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset, batch_size=VAL_BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, num_workers=4
)

print(f"Train batches: {len(train_loader)}, Val batches: {len(val_loader)}")

# Load pretrained ResNet18
model = models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
num_ftrs = model.fc.in_features
model.fc = nn.Sequential(nn.Dropout(0.5), nn.Linear(num_ftrs, len(breed_names)))
model = model.to(device)

# Freeze first few convolutional layers
num_frozen_layers = 6
for layer_name, param in model.named_parameters():
    if "fc" not in layer_name and "conv" in layer_name[: layer_name.index(".") + 2]:
        param.requires_grad = False
        print(f"Frozen: {layer_name}")

# Count trainable parameters
total_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
trainable_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
print(f"Total params: {total_params}, Trainable params: {trainable_params}")


def train_epoch(model, loader, criterion, optimizer, epoch):
    model.train()
    running_loss = 0.0
    for images, targets in loader:
        images, targets = images.to(device), targets.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(images)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        running_loss += loss.item()

        if epoch % 5 == 0:
            print(f"\rEpoch [{epoch}] Loss: {running_loss/len(loader):.4f}", end="")

    return running_loss / len(loader)


def validate_model(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    all_probs = []
    all_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, targets in loader:
            images = images.to(device)
            outputs = model(images)
            probs = torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).cpu().numpy()

            if targets is not None:
                all_probs.append(probs)
                all_labels.extend(targets)
            else:
                all_probs.append(probs)

    if len(all_labels) == 0:
        return np.array(all_probs), 0

    all_probs = np.vstack(all_probs)
    labels_arr = np.array(all_labels)

    # Calculate multiclass log loss
    eps = 1e-7
    y_pred = all_probs[:, :, None]
    y_true = np.zeros_like(y_pred)

    for i, label in enumerate(labels_arr):
        y_true[i, label] = 1.0

    log_loss = -(1 / len(labels_arr)) * np.sum(y_true * np.log(y_pred + eps))

    return all_probs, log_loss


# Training loop
NUM_EPOCHS = 20
CROP_RATE = 0.1
LR = 0.01

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=LR, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(optimizer, step_size=10, gamma=0.5)

best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience_counter = 0
MAX_PATIENCE = 5

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("STARTING TRAINING")
print("=" * 60 + "\n")

for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
    epoch_loss = train_epoch(model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer, epoch)
    scheduler.step()

    # Validate
    _, val_loss = validate_model(model, val_loader)

    print(
        f"\nEpoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {epoch_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f}"
    )

    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        patience_counter = 0
        print("Saving best model!")
        checkpoint = {
            "state_dict": model.state_dict(),
            "epoch": epoch,
            "val_loss": val_loss,
        }
        torch.save(checkpoint, WORKING_DIR / "best_model.pth")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= MAX_PATIENCE:
            print(f"\nEarly stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# Fix: Load best model with weights_only=False to handle PyTorch 2.6 compatibility
if (WORKING_DIR / "best_model.pth").exists():
    print("\nLoading best model...")
    checkpoint = torch.load(
        WORKING_DIR / "best_model.pth", map_location=device, weights_only=False
    )
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["state_dict"])
    model = model.to(device)

# Final validation on hold-out set
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("FINAL VALIDATION ON HOLD-OUT SET")
print("=" * 60)
_, final_val_loss = validate_model(model, val_loader)
print(f"Hold-out validation log loss: {final_val_loss:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("GENERATING TEST PREDICTIONS")
print("=" * 60)

test_ids = sorted([f.name.replace(".jpg", "") for f in TEST_DIR.glob("*.jpg")])
test_dataset = DogDataset(TEST_DIR, ids=test_ids, transform=val_transform)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=64, shuffle=False, num_workers=4)

# Prepare submission dataframe with correct column order
col_order = ["id"] + list(breed_names)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=col_order)

# Initialize with zeros
submission_df["id"] = test_ids
submission_df[breed_names] = 0.0

with torch.no_grad():
    for images in test_loader:
        batch_imgs = images.to(device)
        outputs = model(batch_imgs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1).numpy()

        # Process each image in batch
        for i, prob in enumerate(probs):
            test_id = test_ids[i]
            for j, breed in enumerate(breed_names):
                submission_df.loc[test_id, breed] = round(prob[j], 4)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Cores check: {submission_df.columns.tolist()}")

# Verify submission has correct format
assert "id" in submission_df.columns, "Missing 'id' column"
assert len(submission_df) == len(test_ids), "Mismatch in submission rows"
print(f"\n✓ Submission verification passed")

# Print final log loss
print(f"\nFinal hold-out validation Log Loss: {final_val_loss:.6f}")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print(f"TIME ELAPSED: {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print("=" * 60)
